ev.q: During 2002, a total of 4,156 cases of WNV illness in humans, including 2,946 cases of neuroinvasive disease, were reported to CDC
In all three cases, the infants were born at full term with normal appearance and negative laboratory tests for WNV infection
During 2003, CDC received reports of approximately 9,100 cases of WNV illness
This report summarizes the interim guidelines established during that meeting.
